This page is for you
Companion Animal Travel Desk: Pet Lounge Guidance

We are sorry for any uncertainty around pet travel, and this page offers a clear summary for travelers using Aurelia Skyways. The Companion Animal Travel Desk helps ensure that pets and their handlers move through the skyport with care, patience, and orderly support.

Please keep your animal in its carrier until a staff member gives direct instruction. Soft bedding, clean water, and familiar items can make the waiting area less stressful. If a traveler arrives with a service animal or another companion pet, the crew will guide the handoff and the holding process with attention to welfare and safety.

<<FACT F006>> Please follow the posted signs and the directions of the senior coordinator, since the lounge must remain calm for every animal present. Travelers should also keep noise low, secure leashes, and check that carriers are closed before moving from one area to another.

<<FACT F012>> If your pet shows signs of distress, tell a staff member at once so support can be arranged without delay. We regret that any overlooked step can create discomfort, so the desk reviews each case with care and records the needed details for smooth transfer.

Before departure, confirm that your documents are ready and that the pet has been fed and settled according to crew advice. If you need further assistance, please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk through the main Aurelia Skyways service desk.
